comment: The check-run names a source revision must carry, every one of them
completed/success, before a candidate image may be built from it.
Held in both directions against the workflow files by
and forgotten here fails, and a name listed here whose job no longer exists
fails too. A list that could only shrink silently is not an admission rule.
'skipped' is refused by name in the verifier. A workflow reports success at
the run level when one of its jobs skipped, so a required gate that never
ran looks identical to one that passed unless something asks.
